title: Marfa Lights Unveiled

scenes.text: Over 5,000 sightings reported near Marfa, Texas since 1883
scenes.query: desert night sky with floating lights

scenes.text: Scientists recorded bright orbs moving erratically at 1‑2 km altitude
scenes.query: nighttime desert with glowing orbs over horizon

scenes.text: Local radar once detected the lights traveling faster than sound
scenes.query: radar screen showing fast moving blips over desert
scenes.query2: military radar detecting unknown aerial phenomena

scenes.text: The most plausible explanation is a combination of temperature inversions and distant car headlights, yet many still see them as something else
scenes.query: desert temperature inversion diagram with light paths

scenes.text: Follow if you can't stop asking why.
scenes.query: mystery symbols overlay on night sky

description: The Marfa Lights have baffled observers for over a century. Discover the leading scientific view and why the debate still burns.
